entry.title: Dragon’s Shadow – Handcrafted Custom Pool Cue | Elite Cue
entry.summary:
Vendor: Elite Cue
Type:
Price: 35000.00

Dark, powerful, and unmistakably distinctive, the Dragon’s Shadow is a handcrafted custom pool cue inspired by the strength, mystery, and legendary presence of the dragon. Built from premium palm wood, this cue showcases dramatic natural grain patterns that give every section a unique character, depth, and organic beauty.

The rich palm wood is enhanced by a sleek high-gloss black finish, creating a sophisticated foundation for the centerpiece of the design—the dragon-inspired handcrafted abalone inlays incorporated into the grip. Carefully shaped from shimmering abalone, the intricate inlay work captures the flowing form and spirit of a dragon, revealing flashes of natural color and brilliance as the cue moves under the light.

Complementing the organic character of the palm wood is elegant black and white decorative ringwork, adding clean definition and visual balance throughout the cue. The precision Radial pin completes the construction, providing a solid and secure connection between the butt and shaft.

The Dragon’s Shadow is a striking expression of craftsmanship where natural palm wood, polished black detailing, and handcrafted abalone artistry come together in one distinctive design. Because every piece of palm wood carries its own unique grain pattern, each cue possesses a character that is truly its own.

Specifications

  • Wood: Premium Palm Wood

  • Inlays: Dragon-Inspired Handcrafted Abalone Inlays

  • Grip: Palm Wood with Dragon-Inspired Abalone Inlay Design

  • Finish: High-Gloss Black Finish

  • Ringwork: Custom Black & White Decorative Rings

  • Pin: Radial

  • Construction: Handcrafted Custom Cue

  • Brand: Elite Cue

Dark elegance. Natural character. Legendary craftsmanship. A cue designed to make a statement before the first shot is played. 🐉🎱

entry.title: Dragon – X001
entry.summary:
Vendor: Elite Cue
Type:
Price: 45000.00

Crafted from premium ashwood, this exceptional cue features an intricately handcrafted dragon motif brought to life with shimmering abalone inlays, symbolizing strength, wisdom, and prosperity. Flowing resin accents seamlessly enhance the forearm and butt sleeve, creating remarkable depth, contrast, and visual elegance. The wrapless canadian maple handle preserves the uninterrupted beauty of the natural grain while providing a smooth, comfortable feel and exceptional control.

Engineered for discerning players and collectors, the Imperial Dragon pairs breathtaking artistry with tournament-ready performance. The premium Kielwood shaft delivers outstanding stability and consistency, while the Black Diamond tip, US phenolic ferrule, and precision Radial pin provide a solid, responsive hit with every shot. Completing this premium package is a matching custom extension, seamlessly integrated to complement the cue's striking design.

Specifications

  • Weight: 19 oz
  • Cue Length: 58"
  • Pin: Radial
  • Shaft: Premium Kielwood Shaft
  • Tip: Black Diamond Tip
  • Ferrule: US Phenolic Ferrule
  • Forearm: Premium Ashwood with Handcrafted Dragon Design, Resin & Abalone Inlays
  • Handle: Wrapless Premium Ashwood
  • Butt Sleeve: Premium Ashwood with Resin & Handcrafted Abalone Inlays
  • Accessories: Matching Custom Extension Included

Legendary artistry. Exceptional craftsmanship. Built to perform and destined to be admired for generations. 🎱
